question: Which of the following Bharatnatyam dancers received the prestigious title ‘Sangeetha kala Vibhushanam’ 2020 in Mumbai?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shanta and Vannadil Pudiaveettil Dhananjay**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Shanta and Vannadil Pudiaveettil Dhananjay**, renowned Bharatnatyam dancers, were recipients of the prestigious **'Sangeetha Kala Vibhushanam'** title in 2020.
 
• The title was awarded in Mumbai to recognize their exceptional contributions to the field of classical dance and music.
 
• Shanta and V.P. Dhananjay are celebrated for their unique style and dedication to preserving the rich traditions of Bharatnatyam.
 
• They are known for their collaborative performances and their significant efforts in promoting Indian classical art forms globally.
 
• The **'Sangeetha Kala Vibhushanam'** is a highly regarded honor in the Indian classical arts community, highlighting excellence in performance and contribution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatnatyam**:

 
 
• Bharatnatyam is one of the oldest classical dance forms of India, originating in Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is characterized by intricate footwork, graceful movements, and expressive gestures known as 'mudras'.
 
• The dance form is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and often depicts themes from epics like the Ramayana and Mahabharata.
 
 
 
• **Sangeetha Kala Vibhushanam**:
 
 
• This prestigious title is awarded to artists who demonstrate outstanding contributions to Indian classical music and dance.
 
• The award aims to honor individuals who preserve and promote India's rich cultural heritage.
 
 
 
• **Role of Classical Dance in Indian Culture**:
 
 
• Indian classical dance forms like Bharatnatyam play a vital role in expressing spirituality and storytelling.
 
• They serve as tools for cultural education, passing down traditions to future generations.
 
 
 
• **Global Recognition of Indian Classical Arts**:
 
 
• Indian classical dance and music have gained international acclaim for their artistic depth and spiritual resonance.
 
• Artists like Shanta and V.P. Dhananjay contribute significantly to showcasing India's cultural richness worldwide.
